The name. The movement. The meaning.

So, what's a hippie?

Hippies were part of a cultural movement that began in the 1960s, especially in the US and UK. They were known for their creativity, colourful style, music and art, and for caring about peace, kindness and community.

Why we chose it

We're inspired by the best of that spirit: creativity, kindness and community. That's how we build websites too: creatively, kindly, and with people at the heart of it. Whatever your business looks like, you deserve a website that feels like you.

Freedom

Hippies valued freedom, independence and personal choice.

For your websiteYou own your domain, your site and your accounts. No lock-in, ever.

Peace

They opposed war and believed in harmony and kindness.

For your websiteA calm, friendly process. No jargon, no pressure, no stress.

Creativity

Art, music and new ideas were at the heart of everything they did.

For your websiteFresh, expressive design with real personality. No boring templates.

Individuality

Hippies celebrated being yourself and using your own gifts.

For your websiteYour story, your colours, your voice. Built around you.

Community

They shared, supported each other and looked out for their neighbours.

For your websiteWe open doors for new founders and cheer you on after launch.

Social change

They cared about fairness, the planet and people's wellbeing.

For your websiteMore people, from every background, getting their ideas online.

In today's world, "hippie" often describes someone positive, open-minded, creative and down to earth. That's exactly how we approach every website we build.

How it works

Idea to online in 24 hours.

For 1-page and small business websites, the 24 hours start once we have your payment and your content.

  1. 1

    Tell us your vibe

    Fill in a short, friendly brief: your business, your colours, the feeling you want, plus any photos and logo.

  2. 2

    We design it

    Your website, styled around you. Bold or calm, playful or polished. It's your call.

  3. 3

    You check it out

    We send a private preview link. Tell us what to tweak and we make one round of changes.

  4. 4

    You go live

    Domain connected, contact forms working, Google set up. Share it with the world.

Community prices: who qualifies?

You qualify if either of these is true:

  • You're aged 16–25 and starting your own business or side hustle
  • Whatever your age (16+), you're starting your own business or side hustle and you're care-experienced, a lone parent, on a low income, facing homelessness or sofa surfing, living with a physical disability, or neurodivergent (for example autistic, ADHD or dyslexic)

Going through a hard time that isn't on this list? If you know, honestly and with integrity, that this is a time of real difficulty for you, choose Community prices. We trust you.

Then every website category is £149, no matter how many pages or features you need. The only exception is the Shop & Log-in Website, which will be £349 for you instead of the full price of £449. Plus half-price monthly website care. You keep these prices after the launch offer ends.

Website care (optional)

Daily backups, security updates, up to 1 hour of changes every month, a monthly report, and a reminder before your domain or hosting renews. Cancel any time.

Prices include design, build and launch. After that, your only yearly running cost is domain & hosting: up to £30 a year, set up in your name. Shop and log-in websites need bigger hosting, which we'll price for you before you start.

My story

I'm Krissie, the 19-year-old behind Hippie Websites.

Every business has a beginning. Mine started at home, with my mum sitting beside me, teaching me how to code and build websites and apps.

The moment I knew I could really do this was when she handed me one of her own client projects: a website for a hair salon. I built the whole thing without asking her for help once. When she saw it, she told me I was better than her. I'll never forget that feeling. It gave me confidence, independence and the belief that I could create something of my own.

Not everyone has someone like that: someone who believes in them, teaches them and helps them take the first step. That's what I want to be for others. It's why I offer Community prices for young people and adults who need them, and why I'm creating The Hippie Circle.

My mum opened a door for me. Now I want to hold it open for others.

Support workers, youth services and councils: you're welcome to point young founders my way.

Freedom, for real

        
Your website is yours.

        
Some designers keep your domain and logins so you can't leave. Not us. Everything is set up in your name, and we never ask for your passwords.

      

      

        
Your domain, your name
Your web address is registered to you. If you ever move on, it goes with you.

        
Payments go straight to you
Shops use your own Stripe account, so customer money lands in your bank, never ours.

        
Team invites, not shared passwords
You add us as a team member and can remove us whenever you like.

        
Your code, on request
Want to take your site elsewhere? We'll hand everything over, no drama.

      

    

  


  

    

      

        
Questions

        
Good vibes, straight answers.

      

      

        
Do I need to be a hippie to work with you?
Not at all. The name is about the spirit: freedom, creativity and doing things your way. We build calm, professional sites just as happily as colourful ones.

        
Is it really live in 24 hours?
Yes, for 1-page and small business websites. The clock starts once we have your payment and everything in the brief. Bigger websites take 3–5 days and shop and log-in websites 1–3 weeks, because bookings, shops and log-ins need extra care.

        
I'm not in the UK. Can you still help?
Yes. We build for people in the UK, United States, Canada, Africa and anywhere else. You can pay in pounds, US dollars or Canadian dollars.

        
I don't have a logo or photos yet. Is that OK?
Totally fine. We can create a simple text logo and use quality stock photos, so you can launch now and swap them in later.

        
Can you update my site after launch?
Yes. Website care includes up to 1 hour of changes every month. Without it, we charge a fixed hourly rate for updates.
